source: Rust persistence test harness using SqliteStore::open/load_state plus Rust-generated Context, Project, Repository, RepositoryLocation, and Workspace write fixture

rustSource.writeFixtureGenerator: src-tauri/src/persistence/tests.rs::generate_context_write_compatibility_fixture_for_typescript (updated for ContextCreated + ProjectCreated and Project/Repository/Workspace writes)

typescriptDatabaseOpenValidation.result: passed against a fresh database created by this SqliteStore
typescriptDatabaseOpenValidation.note: One-off cross-runtime validation; the temporary Rust test was removed after the run.

coverage: All persisted tables, including populated JSON columns; expected state captured from Rust load_state; Context creation with its Default Project, Project create/update, Repository register/update, RepositoryLocation update, Workspace and WorkspaceRepository creation, full Context configuration and attention writes, metadata sequences, pstack-role JSON, and ContextCreated + ProjectCreated + RepositoryRegistered audit actions are generated by Rust. Selected Machine and provider profiles, executable paths, Atlassian/Azure DevOps/Bitbucket targets, and close/reopen verification are included.
fixturePreparation: After Rust capture, settings contains setup_completed=true and provider_choice=none so every persisted table has a row. These settings do not participate in DomainState.

typescriptWriteCompatibility.test: src/main/persistence/sqlite-store.test.ts::matches the Rust-generated Context write compatibility fixture byte for byte
typescriptWriteCompatibility.result: passed; exact SQLite Context/Project/Repository/location/Workspace rows, compact pstack_roles_json, attention rows, sequence counters, and ordered audit action_json values are compared with Rust output; selected Machine/profile and provider settings survive reopening the store
